title: The logo orbit: rings that show and equal marks
goal:
Krish looked at the v3 stills (2 Nov) and sent the logo orbit back for two misses; keep everything else v3 did (tiles, overshoot, chips, highlight), which he accepted. Start from the v3 code on main's ve-card/ve-thu-2-logo-orbit-v3 branch if present, else from main.

1. The rings must be plainly visible on the light ground. In v3 they do not show at all in the rendered stills: mint at 50% opacity on cream is near-invisible and the draw-on mask hides them. Draw each ring in tokens.inkSoft at no less than 35% opacity, stroke at least 6 px, plus the dashed inner ring, and once drawn on they stay fully drawn until exit. Contrast of ring against ground at least 1.6:1 in the rendered pixels.
2. Every mark is the same visual size. In v3 the Meta and xAI marks render far smaller than Google, Amazon and Anthropic. Fit each mark by its own drawn bounding box (not its file's viewBox, which has padding) into the same 96 px box, so its long side is 96 px within 10%. For Meta and xAI use the symbol (the Meta infinity, the xAI X) from config/logo-registry.json / assets/logos, not a wordmark.

## Tests
- in a rendered still after all rings are drawn, ring pixels differ from the ground by a contrast ratio of at least 1.6:1
- each ring stays fully drawn from its draw-on end until exit
- every mark's drawn bounding box long side is within 10% of 96 px, Meta and xAI included
- the v3 tests (tiles, overshoot, chips, highlight, both aspects) still pass
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): `Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame})`, a pure function of its props; state only from `stateAt(events, object.obj, frame)`, animation only from `progress()` and `drift()` with `MOTION` timing; colours only from `tokens` (raw hex refused); type roles from `HOUSE_FONTS`; no `Math.random`, no `f % N`, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in `devices/registry.ts` (one line) and in `config/ve/devices.json` with exactly the verbs below, and update `verbs.test.ts`. No person, no real brand mascot, no on-screen text beyond what params give. Look: the house tokens on a light ground, soft shadows, real-UI realism, as in Krish's references (light-grey kinetic explainer with a cute cursor character; app logos orbiting a central icon on rings with motion blur on arrival).
